findings.detail: pageSize = min(batchSize*2, 50); list discover uses cursor next_page_url — no completed-page refetch when checkpoint present.
enrichFromCluster skipped when citation OR docket_number already present on list hit.
Extra GET /opinions/{id}/ only when list text < 200 chars — required for chunking quality.
Optional docket GET only when still missing docket after cluster enrich; enables honest unreported labeling.
Retry-After > 300 returns 429 to caller; batch job exits rate_limited and writes /tmp/cl-batch-result.json.
No CourtListener API usage/quota endpoint wired yet — stop-before-limit needs that after cooldown (still zero calls this run).
CL_COURT_MAP is local static — no /courts/ rediscovery on each batch.

codeChangesThisRun: none — no clear amplification bug without harming metadata quality
